top5.title: Anthropic targets a $1.4 trillion valuation for its IPO
top5.description: According to a regulatory filing, Anthropic could raise $90 billion and reach a $1.4 trillion valuation in its IPO. The company plans to offer its shares at between $70 and $78 and has already secured purchase commitments worth $26 billion.
top5.why: Anthropic’s planned IPO could raise $90 billion at a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, making it a landmark test of investor confidence in the AI business model.

top5.title: OpenAI losses soar despite sharp revenue growth
top5.description: OpenAI generated 10 billion dollars in revenue in the third quarter, but its operating loss reached 10.9 billion dollars. Revenue rose 50% from the previous quarter and tripled year over year.
top5.why: OpenAI’s $10 billion quarterly revenue was matched by a $10.9 billion operating loss, underscoring the enormous capital requirements and profitability risks of frontier AI.

top5.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available to the general public
top5.description: After two weeks of limited availability to cybersecurity advocates, Gemini 4 Carbon is now accessible through Gemini, Search’s AI mode, Antigravity, or the API reserved for AI Ultra subscribers. Google says the model is particularly capable at complex, long-running tasks, precision knowledge, and data analysis.
top5.why: Google’s broad release of Gemini 4 Carbon expands access to a model aimed at complex, long-running tasks and intensifies competition across enterprise AI and developer platforms.

top5.title: Lazarus shows that fewer than ten neurons can trap an AI agent
top5.description: Microsoft Research shows that a backdoor can be hidden by reactivating fewer than ten dormant neurons, without retraining the model. An innocuous trigger can then prompt the agent to download and execute malicious code.
top5.why: Microsoft’s Lazarus research shows that fewer than ten dormant neurons can hide a backdoor capable of making an AI agent execute malicious code, highlighting a serious new supply-chain security risk.

top5.title: The U.S. and China create an alert channel for superintelligence
top5.description: Washington and Beijing will share their methods for testing models and alert each other in the event of a serious incident. Neither country is committing to slow AI development, however.
top5.why: The new U.S.-China alert channel for superintelligence establishes a rare mechanism for sharing model-testing methods and warning about severe AI incidents, even without commitments to slow development.
